data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Stephanos', which means 'crown' or 'garland'. In the New Testament, St. Stephen is the first Christian martyr. His name has been a popular choice for both boys and girls throughout history. The name Stephenie carries the meaning “Crown of garlands” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Stephenie usually hope their child will grow to embody crown of garlands and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Stephenie has a rich cultural history, particularly in the Christian tradition. It evokes the memory of St. Stephen, the first Christian martyr considered as a model of faith and charity. The name has been passed down through generations and continues to be admired for its connection to this important figure in Christian history.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Stephenie holds deep spiritual significance as it reminds us of St. Stephen's unwavering faith and commitment to God, even in the face of persecution. It implies strength, courage, and a deep connection to one's spiritual beliefs. Those who bear this name may be inspired by St. Stephen's story to live their lives with faith, kindness, and a strong sense of moral values.
